events.text: The inspector opens the arson case file on Monday morning.
events.cf_text: The inspector opens the arson case file on Monday morning.

events.text: Three nights before the fire, Elena had already hidden a spare key under the mat.
events.cf_text: Three nights before the fire, Marisol had already hidden a spare key under the mat.

events.text: On Tuesday, he re-interviews the landlord about the building's history.
events.cf_text: On Tuesday, he re-interviews the landlord about the building's history.

events.text: The next night, Elena let herself in with the hidden key just as the neighbor's dog stopped barking.
events.cf_text: The next night, Marisol let herself in with the hidden key just as the neighbor's dog stopped barking.

events.text: Elena's flashlight beam vanished from the window the instant the smoke alarm began to blare.
events.cf_text: Marisol's flashlight beam vanished from the window the instant the smoke alarm began to blare.

events.text: That same night, Mrs. Kade had been logging every noise from the house since sundown, and her log entry ends the moment the alarm sounds.
events.cf_text: That same night, Mr. Oyelaran had been logging every noise from the house since sundown, and his log entry ends the moment the alarm sounds.

events.text: By Wednesday, he learns the landlord filed an insurance claim the same week as the fire.
events.cf_text: By Wednesday, he learns the landlord filed an insurance claim the same week as the fire.

events.text: Mrs. Kade's full week of notes, spanning Monday through Sunday, entirely contains the single night of the fire.
events.cf_text: Mr. Oyelaran's full week of notes, spanning Wednesday through the following Tuesday, entirely contains the single night of the fire.

events.text: He arrests Elena on Thursday, one day after learning of the claim.
events.cf_text: He arrests Elena on Thursday, one day after learning of the claim.

events.text: That same Monday afternoon, Voss walks the scorched ground floor of the house himself.
events.cf_text: That same Wednesday afternoon, Renner walks the scorched ground floor of the house himself.

events.text: By Tuesday evening, he has the fire marshal's forensic report open on his desk.
events.cf_text: By Tuesday evening, he has the fire marshal's forensic report open on his desk.

events.text: Wednesday afternoon, Voss requests a warrant for the landlord's financial records.
events.cf_text: Friday afternoon, Renner requests a warrant for the landlord's financial records.

events.text: Thursday afternoon, Voss books Elena into holding after the arrest.
events.cf_text: Saturday afternoon, Renner books Marisol into holding after the arrest.

events.text: By Friday, Voss closes the file, satisfied the timeline finally holds together.
events.cf_text: By Sunday, Renner closes the file, satisfied the timeline finally holds together.

events.cf_time_expr: earlier that same night, before letting herself in
events.text: Earlier that same night, before letting herself in, Elena had watched the house from across the street.

events.cf_time_expr: just inside the door, moments after entering
events.text: Just inside the door, Elena's flashlight beam swept the dark hallway.
events.cf_text: Just inside the door, Marisol's flashlight beam swept the dark hallway.

events.text: Minutes later, in the study, Elena rifled through a drawer of the landlord's old papers.
events.cf_text: Minutes later, in the study, Marisol rifled through a drawer of the landlord's old papers.

events.time_expr: as she straightened from the drawer
events.cf_time_expr: as she straightened from the drawer
events.text: As Elena straightened from the drawer, a curl of smoke reached the ceiling behind her.
events.cf_text: As Marisol straightened from the drawer, a curl of smoke reached the ceiling behind her.

events.time_expr: in the seconds after the alarm
events.cf_time_expr: in the seconds after the alarm
events.text: In the seconds after the alarm, Elena bolted for the back door.
events.cf_text: In the seconds after the alarm, Marisol bolted for the back door.

events.time_expr: by the time she reached the street
events.cf_time_expr: by the time she reached the street
events.text: By the time she reached the street, sirens were already rising in the distance.
events.cf_text: By the time she reached the street, sirens were already rising in the distance.

events.text: At nine that night, Marta had been pacing by the phone, waiting for Elena to call.
events.cf_text: At nine that night, Dara had been pacing by the phone, waiting for Marisol to call.

events.time_expr: twenty past nine until just after ten
events.cf_time_expr: twenty past nine until just after ten
events.text: By twenty past nine, Marta had driven to the street and sat idling in her car a block away.
events.cf_text: By twenty past nine, Dara had driven to the street and sat idling in her car a block away.

events.time_expr: shortly before ten, from the car
events.cf_time_expr: shortly before ten, from the car
events.text: From the car, Marta watched Elena slip through the gate just as the porch light flickered.
events.cf_text: From the car, Dara watched Marisol slip through the gate just as the porch light flickered.

events.text: Minutes later, Marta checked her phone again for a message that never came.
events.cf_text: Minutes later, Dara checked her phone again for a message that never came.

events.text: The instant the alarm's wail reached the car, Marta's stomach dropped.
events.cf_text: The instant the alarm's wail reached the car, Dara's stomach dropped.

events.text: Moments after, Marta saw the first flashing lights before Elena reappeared at the corner.
events.cf_text: Moments after, Dara saw the first flashing lights before Marisol reappeared at the corner.

events.text: She pulled the car around to the back street to meet her.
events.cf_text: She pulled the car around to the back street to meet her.

events.time_expr: in the drive away from the scene
events.cf_time_expr: in the drive away from the scene
events.text: She drove Elena away from the scene, taking the long way past the river.
events.cf_text: She drove Marisol away from the scene, taking the long way past the river.

events.text: In the weeks that followed, Marta rehearsed the story so often in her head that she began to believe her own version of it.
events.cf_text: In the weeks that followed, Dara rehearsed the story so often in her head that she began to believe her own version of it.

events.text: That Monday, Mrs. Kade's log records a quiet evening with no visitors.
events.cf_text: That Wednesday, Mr. Oyelaran's log records a quiet evening with no visitors.

events.text: On Tuesday, she notes the landlord's car idling outside twice.
events.cf_text: On Thursday, he notes the landlord's car idling outside twice.

events.time_expr: within minutes of the alarm, that same night
events.cf_time_expr: within minutes of the alarm, that same night
events.text: Within minutes of the alarm, she logs the fire trucks arriving on the street.
events.cf_text: Within minutes of the alarm, he logs the fire trucks arriving on the street.

events.text: By Thursday, her log notes reporters gathering outside the gate.
events.cf_text: By Saturday, his log notes reporters gathering outside the gate.

events.text: Friday's entry records the insurance adjuster's visit to the wreckage.
events.cf_text: Sunday's entry records the insurance adjuster's visit to the wreckage.

events.text: On Saturday, she notes the house finally sealed behind police tape.
events.cf_text: On Monday, he notes the house finally sealed behind police tape.

events.text: Her final entry, on Sunday, notes the street was quiet again.
events.cf_text: His final entry, on Tuesday, notes the street was quiet again.
